Definition: Abdi, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Abdi = "servant of Jehovah"; 1) a Merarite Levite and ancestor of Ethan the singer; 2) a Merarite Levite, father of Kish, in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah; 3) one of the family of Elam who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
